# Trace v0.2.0 — indexing & performance overhaul

Local multimodal semantic search for your files, powered by Google EmbeddingGemma 2 (int8 ONNX, fully offline).

## What's new / 更新内容

**Indexing v2 / 索引 v2**
- Adaptive + content-aware sampling; per-file fingerprint and content dedup / 自适应采样 + 内容感知 + 按文件指纹 + 内容去重
- Video scene mode: keyframe-only decoding + aHash scene detection with cap-based thinning / 视频抽帧改场景模式：仅解码关键帧 + aHa
- Single-file SQLite index: FTS5 (trigram BM25) + sqlite-vec (cosine), z-score fusion ranking
